faq.question: Can you fix or improve my existing WooCommerce store?
faq.answer: Yes. I fix checkout and layout issues, improve speed and redesign product and category pages.

faq.question: How much does a WooCommerce store cost?
faq.answer: It depends on products, features and integrations. Tell me what you sell and I’ll send a clear, fixed quote.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: A typical store takes 3–6 weeks, depending on the number of products and integrations.

faq.question: Do you maintain sites you didn’t build?
faq.answer: Yes. I can look after any WordPress site, whichever theme or builder it uses, after a quick health check.

faq.question: What happens if my site breaks?
faq.answer: I restore it from a recent backup or fix the issue directly, then find and prevent the cause.

faq.question: Are content changes included?
faq.answer: Yes, small text, image and page updates are included. Larger changes are quoted separately.

faq.question: How much does maintenance cost?
faq.answer: Plans are priced monthly based on your site’s size and needs. Tell me about your site and I’ll send a clear quote.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Yes. There are no long lock-ins, and you keep full access to your site and backups.
